# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Carmody  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v3 c4 P15](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0015), [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with golden-white hair and a tall, slender figure. She has a high-bred, fair appearance, though she once self-deprecatingly considered herself too tall compared to others.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 c26 P17](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0017), [v3 c35 P4](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla is studious, imaginative, and possesses a keen sense of humor and mischief beneath her pale, quiet exterior. She enjoys nature, poetry, and good fellowship, and shares a deep, sympathetic bond of friendship with her college companions. She is also practical and conscientious regarding her academic and personal pursuits.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 c13 P67](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0067), [v3 c37 P21](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0021)_

- To live a rich and meaningful life filled with art, literature, and friendship  <sub>[v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley and later taught at the school in Carmody. Desiring to further her education, she resigned from her teaching position and enrolled at Redmond College in Kingsport alongside Anne. Together with Anne, Philippa Gordon, and Stella Maynard, she lived at Patty's Place under the care of Aunt Jamesina, enjoying a rich social and academic life. During her college years, she specialized in Classics, eventually earning High Honors upon graduation. After completing her studies at Redmond, Priscilla travelled to Japan to work or teach, continuing her life's adventures abroad.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c36 P12](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0012), [v4 c3 P10](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0010)_
